blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Saturday urged businesses across Southeast Asia to make artificial intelligence (AI) tools more affordable and accessible to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), saying smaller businesses must be equipped to compete in an increasingly technology-driven economy. In a video message shown during the Asean Business and Investment Summit (ABIS) 2026 in Manila, Marcos called on technology companies to provide accessible AI tools, investors to support enterprises with growth potential, and established businesses to open their supply chains and share expertise with smaller firms. “For MSMEs, we are advancing an approach that brings AI adoption […]...
